events.verdict: Vucevic (ORL) and Embiid (PHI) briefly engage and disengage with one another.
Ross (ORL) exits the paint within three seconds.
Vucevic (ORL) collapses his arm and absorbs the contact with Embiid (PHI) during his driving shot attempt.
Covington (PHI) does not make contact to the arm of Augustin (ORL) and affect his ability to maintain possession of the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Augustin (ORL) gathers the ball and then continues his dribble.
Vucevic (ORL) places a hand on the opposite side/hip of Saric (PHI) while trying to establish position in the post, but immediately removes his hand.
Vucevic (ORL) briefly holds Saric's (PHI) arm in the post while attempting to establish position but the contact is marginal.
Fournier (ORL) makes incidental contact with Embiid (PHI) during the loose ball.
Ross (ORL) places two hands on the body of Covington (PHI) in the lane, but he immediately removes both hands.
Fournier (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position during Redick's (PHI) drive.
Saric (PHI) lifts his pivot foot prior to the start of his dribble.
Gordon (ORL) puts a hand/forearm to the front of Saric (PHI) during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Fournier (ORL) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Covington (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position during Fournier's (ORL) drive.
Saric (PHI) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Covington (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Fournier's (ORL) path and does not deliver the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Vucevic (ORL) enters the lane prior to the release of Embiid's (PHI) free throw attempt.
Ross (ORL) wraps two hands around the body of Embiid (PHI) and the contact affects his SQBR.
Vucevic (ORL) establishes himself in a legal screening position in Covington's (PHI) path.
Saric (PHI) is in a legal guarding position and jumps vertically contesting the driving shot attempt by Gordon (ORL).
Redick (PHI) makes marginal contact with Ross (ORL) and does not push him and dislodge him from his position.
Embiid (PHI) briefly extends his arms while disengaging from the pick but he does not push Ross (ORL).
Saric (PHI) engages with Fournier (ORL) but does not affect his FOM.
Saric (PHI) briefly places two hands around Vucevic (ORL) but he removes them and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Redick (PHI) makes contact to the head of Gordon (ORL) during his jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (ORL) and Embiid (PHI) make incidental contact during the loose ball.
Covington (PHI) and Vucevic (ORL) make incidental contact during the loose ball.
Covington (PHI) places a hand on the side/hip of Ross (ORL) but immediately removes it.
Johnson (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position on Ross' (ORL) jump shot attempt.
